name: contextgate
description: Zero-LLM prompt compression, MMR context pruning, tool schema compression, live Old vs. New prompt stats, and side-by-side Raw vs. Optimized LLM evaluation.

chatParticipants.name: contextgate
chatParticipants.description: Compare Raw vs. Deterministically Optimized prompts on real workspace files via Copilot (vscode.lm) or HuggingFace (app.py).

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Run Raw vs. Optimized prompt side-by-side on the downstream LLM and audit compliance

contextGate.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter (auto-detects NLP-start/bin/python or .venv/bin/python if left as python3).

contextGate.engineDirectory.description: Path to directory containing bridge_server.py, app.py, and pipeline.py (defaults to extension root).

contextGate.autoShowLogs.description: Automatically reveal the ContextGate Output panel when an optimization runs.

contextGate.optimizeOnSave.description: Automatically update the alongside Old vs. New Prompt Comparison Inspector whenever a file is saved.

contextGate.downstreamBackend.description: Downstream LLM backend for side-by-side comparison ('auto' uses vscode.lm Copilot if available, else HuggingFace app.py).

contextGate.huggingFaceToken.description: Optional HuggingFace API token (HF_TOKEN) when using the HuggingFace app.py backend.

contextGate.huggingFaceModel.description: HuggingFace model ID for app.py downstream evaluation.

contextGate.maxTokenBudget.description: Maximum total token budget for the compiled prompt payload.

contextGate.auditLogFile.markdownDescription: Optional file that receives a copy of the audit log. **The log contains previews of your prompts**, so nothing is written to disk unless you set this. The live stream in the ContextGate Output panel is always available.
